items.originalTitle: Horner would only return to pit wall for 'dream' Ferrari job
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner says Ferrari is the only Formula 1 job that could tempt him back onto the pit wall without an ownership stake, calling the Italian team the biggest brand in F1 and a "dream" role.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳："梦想中的"法拉利职位是唯一能诱使这位前红牛老板在没有股权的情况下重返围场墙边的F1工作
克里斯蒂安·霍纳自2025年7月被解雇红牛车队领队一职后便离开了F1；周六中午12点观看阿塞拜疆大奖赛，上午10点30分开始预热节目，在天空体育 F1和Main Event直播
回顾克里斯蒂安·霍纳执掌期间红牛与法拉利的一些最佳对决。
克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，法拉利的一个"梦想"职位是唯一能诱使他在没有股权的情况下重返围场墙边的F1工作。
霍纳在2025年7月英国大奖赛后被解除红牛车队领队和首席执行官的职务，结束了他在米尔顿凯恩斯车队极为成功的20年执掌生涯。
在离开红牛后的一段时期内，霍纳无法为其他车队工作，此后他一直在探索重返F1的可能途径，他的首选是获得某支车队的股权。

然而，由于在这方面尚未出现可行的机会，霍纳承认法拉利是他唯一会考虑以常规车队领队身份加入的车队。
"我一直是个雇佣兵。我在围场墙边坐了21年。我不需要再回到那里，"霍纳告诉《泰晤士报》。
霍纳在2026年7月英国大奖赛上接受天空体育 F1采访时谈到了他重返这项运动的前景。
"在我人生的这个阶段，只有一支车队我会接受不参与所有权。
"我会考虑法拉利吗？我的意思是，法拉利是F1最大的品牌。这是梦想。可以说它是F1的沉睡巨人。"

法拉利车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔于2025年7月签署了一份多年续约合同，但似乎再次未能终结这支意大利车队对车队总冠军或车手总冠军的等待，这一等待可追溯到2008年。
霍纳在F1中见证了红牛的两个统治时期，塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔和车队在2010-2013年连续赢得四个车手和车队总冠军，马克斯·维斯塔潘在2021-2024年赢得四个车手总冠军，并在2022年和2023年赢得车队总冠军。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿去年表示，将克里斯蒂安·霍纳与法拉利联系起来的传闻对车队来说"分散注意力"。
他补充道："我认为，离开这项运动14个月后，他们还在谈论我，这说明仍然有需求。也许我并没有那么不受欢迎。"
当被问及明年是否能重返F1发车格时，霍纳回答说："我不知道。我既是解药也是问题。"
霍纳：沃尔夫需要被"揉乱头发"
霍纳在红牛任期的最后十年里，与梅赛德斯同僚托托·沃尔夫发展出了一段常常充满敌意的恩怨。
两人毫不掩饰对彼此的厌恶，因为他们的车队在争夺冠军，最引人注目的是维斯塔潘在2021年有争议地击败刘易斯·汉密尔顿夺得车手总冠军。
谈到重返F1的动机，霍纳透露他认为沃尔夫在他缺席期间"过得很轻松"。
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫讨论克里斯蒂安·霍纳被红牛解雇一事。
"总有那么一个时刻，车队的竞争力会超过其他自负的东西，"霍纳说。
"我很幸运，可以挑剔。如果我什么都不做，我可以在这里度过余生，只担心会不会下雨、草会不会变绿。
"但那能让我满足吗？不能。我仍然觉得还有另一场舞会。而托托需要被好好揉乱头发。
"我不在的时候他过得很轻松。那他为什么要我回来？我可能会比任何人都更让他难受。"

detailEn: Christian Horner: 'Dream' Ferrari role is only F1 job that could tempt former Red Bull boss back to pit wall without ownership stake

Christian Horner has been out of F1 since being sacked as Red Bull team principal in July 2025; watch the Azerbaijan GP on Saturday at 12pm with build-up from 10.30am, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
Relive some of Red Bull's best battles with Ferrari during Christian Horner's time in charge.
Christian Horner says a "dream" role at Ferrari is the only Formula 1 job that could tempt him back onto the pit wall without an ownership stake.

Horner was relieved of his dual roles as Red Bull team principal and chief executive following the British Grand Prix in July 2025, ending a hugely successful 20-year stint running the Milton Keynes squad.

Having seen out a period following his Red Bull departure during which he was unable to take up work with other teams, Horner has been exploring possible routes back into F1, with his preferred option being to acquire equity of a team.

However, with a viable opportunity yet to materialise on that front, Horner has admitted Ferrari are the only team he would consider joining in a regular team principal position.
"I've been a hired hand. I did 21 years sitting on the pit wall. I don't need to go back to that," Horner told The Times.
Horner spoke to Sky Sports F1 at the the 2026 British GP in July about his prospects of returning to the sport.
"At this stage in my life, there's only one team for which I would accept non-participation in ownership.
"Would I consider Ferrari? I mean, Ferrari is the biggest brand in Formula 1. It's the dream. And arguably it's the sleeping giant of Formula 1."

Ferrari team principal Frederic Vasseur signed a multi-year contract extension in July 2025, but appears to have once more failed to end the Italian squad's wait for a constructors' or drivers' title, which stretches back to 2008.

Horner oversaw two periods of Red Bull dominance in F1, with Sebastian Vettel and the team winning four consecutive drivers' and constructors' championships from 2010-2013 and Max Verstappen winning four drivers' championships from 2021-2024, along with constructors' titles in 2022 and 2023.
Lewis Hamilton said last year that rumours linking Christian Horner with Ferrari were 'distracting' for the team.
He added: "I think the fact that, 14 months out of the sport, they're still talking about me shows that there's still a demand. Perhaps I wasn't that unpopular."
When asked if he could be back on the F1 grid by next year, Horner replied: "I don't know. I'm the cure and the problem."
Horner: Wolff needs to have his hair ruffled up
The last decade of Horner's tenure at Red Bull saw the development of an often-bitter feud with his Mercedes counterpart Toto Wolff.
The pair made no secret of their distaste for each other as their teams battled for titles, most notably when Verstappen controversially pipped Lewis Hamilton to the 2021 drivers' title.
Considering his motivations for returning to F1, Horner revealed his belief that Wolff is "having it easy" in his absence.
Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff discusses Christian Horner's sacking from Red Bull.
"There comes a point in time where a team's competitiveness outweighs other egotistical stuff," Horner said.

"I'm in a very fortunate position that I can afford to be picky. If I don't do anything, I can live here for whatever time I've got left on the planet, and just worry about whether it's going to rain and make the grass green or not.
"But is that going to fulfil me? No. I still feel that there's another dance. And Toto needs to have his hair f****** ruffled up.
"He's having it easy while I'm not there. So why would he want me back? I'm probably going to give him a harder time than anybody else."

items.titleZh: 维斯塔潘领跑2026阿塞拜疆大奖赛三练
items.summaryZh: 红牛车手维斯塔潘在2026年F1阿塞拜疆大奖赛第三次练习赛中做出1分43.922秒的最快圈速，以0.099秒优势力压梅赛德斯车手拉塞尔，本赛季首次领跑三练。
items.originalTitle: What happened in F1 2026 Azerbaijan GP final practice
items.summaryEn: Red Bull driver Max Verstappen set the fastest time of 1m43.922s in final practice for the 2026 Formula 1 Azerbaijan Grand Prix, beating Mercedes' George Russell by 0.099s to top an FP3 session for the first time this season.
detailZh: 红牛F1车手马克斯·维斯塔潘在2026年阿塞拜疆大奖赛繁忙的第三次练习赛中，以十分之一秒的优势领先梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔。
周四的标杆拉塞尔在巴库三练的大部分时间里再次成为基准，一度领先梅赛德斯队友基米·安东内利十分之六秒。
但随着练习赛接近尾声，维斯塔潘逐渐缩小了与拉塞尔最快圈速的差距。他在软胎上的第一次尝试落后超过一秒，下一次尝试便插入两辆梅赛德斯之间，之后又将差距缩小到十分之一秒以内，最终借助夏尔·勒克莱尔法拉利的小尾流，做出本节最快圈速1分43.922秒。
方格旗挥动时，维斯塔潘本有望跑得更快，那是他这套软胎的第11圈，但他在紧凑的15号左弯锁死并第二次冲入缓冲区。
尽管如此，维斯塔潘仍本赛季首次领跑三练，拉塞尔——他本人也在后期锁死，并在7号右弯险些滑向护墙——以0.099秒之差位列第二。
拉塞尔的梅赛德斯是刘易斯·汉密尔顿在主直道上能借助尾流的三辆车之一，汉密尔顿因此在练习赛结束时跃升至第三。此前他在车库待了一段时间，法拉利检查了他的左前刹车。
积分榜领先者安东内利最终位列第四，落后0.351秒，勒克莱尔落后十分之六秒排名第五，蒙扎杆位得主皮埃尔·加斯利在后期为阿尔派跃升至第六。
迈凯伦再次不在状态。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在练习赛中抱怨进入第一弯时“信心非常低”，但得益于尾流，他是较快的迈凯伦车手，排名第七，领先队友兰多·诺里斯十分之一秒半。
伊萨克·哈贾尔在没有尾流助力且抱怨交通的情况下，落后红牛队友维斯塔潘1.2秒排名第九，佛朗哥·科拉平托让阿尔派占据前十中的两席——刚好领先威廉姆斯的卡洛斯·塞恩斯。
但中游集团看起来尤为拥挤。从第10名到第17名仅相差半秒，凯迪拉克的塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯再次身处其中。他排名第16，落后2.082秒。
这意味着亚历克斯·阿尔本（威廉姆斯）和两位小红牛车手都处于后六名，费尔南多·阿隆索为阿斯顿·马丁排名第20，落后2.590秒，略有起色。
尽管风力增强，多位车手错过弯心，阿隆索的队友兰斯·斯特罗尔出现了唯一值得注意的事故，他在第一弯擦到了维修区墙。
他起初以为那导致了爆胎，但随后被要求停车，并冲入4号左弯之后的缓冲区。
19 阿尔维德·林德布拉德（小红牛）+2.349秒
20 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.590秒
detailEn: Red Bull Formula 1 driver Max Verstappen headed Mercedes' George Russell by a tenth of a second in a busy final practice session for the 2026 Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
Thursday pacesetter Russell was the benchmark once again for much of FP3 in Baku, at one point heading Mercedes team-mate Kimi Antonelli by six tenths of a second.

But Verstappen gradually chipped away at his best time as the session moved towards its conclusion. Having been more than a second off with his first attempt on softs, he split the Mercedes on his next attempt, got within a tenth of Russell after that, and finally set the session's best time, a 1m43.922s, with a small slipstream assist from Charles Leclerc's Ferrari.

Verstappen had been on course to go faster still as the chequered flag fell, on what was his 11th lap on that set of soft tyres, but he locked up and took to the runoff at the tight Turn 15 left-hander for a second time in the session.

Nevertheless, Verstappen still topped an FP3 session for the first time this season, with Russell - who had a late lock-up of his own and just avoided skating into the barrier at the Turn 7 right-hander - 0.099s down in second.

Russell's Mercedes was one of three cars that Lewis Hamilton was able to gain a slipstream from along the main straight as he jumped to third at the end of the session. Hamilton had spent some time in the garage prior to that while Ferrari inspected his front-left brake.
Championship leader Antonelli ended up fourth, 0.351s down, with Leclerc six tenths back in fifth and Monza polesitter Pierre Gasly jumping up to sixth late on for Alpine.

The McLarens again were not in the picture. Oscar Piastri complained mid-session of having "very low confidence" into the first corner but he was the faster McLaren in seventh thanks to a tow, a tenth and a half ahead of team-mate Lando Norris.

Isack Hadjar was 1.2s off Red Bull team-mate Verstappen in ninth, without a tow assist and complaining of traffic, with Franco Colapinto making it two Alpines in the top 10 - just ahead of Williams's Carlos Sainz.
But the midfield pack looked particularly congested. Just half a second covered 10th down to 17th, with Cadillac's Sergio Perez again in that mix. He was 16th, 2.082s off the pace.
That meant Alex Albon (Williams) and both Racing Bulls drivers were in the bottom six, with Fernando Alonso a mildly encouraging 2.590s off the pace for Aston Martin in 20th.
Despite the wind picking up and a number of drivers missing apexes, Alonso's team-mate Lance Stroll had the only real incident of note when he clipped the pitwall through the first corner.
He initially thought that had caused a puncture but was then asked to stop the car and took to the runoff beyond the Turn 4 left-hander.
19 Arvid Lindblad (Racing Bulls) +2.349s
20 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.590s
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在尾声借助尾流升至第三，此前法拉利曾检查其左前刹车。
积分榜领先者安东内利位列第四，落后0.351秒；勒克莱尔第五，加斯利第六。

Championship leader Antonelli ended up fourth, 0.351s down, with Leclerc fifth and Gasly sixth.
McLaren again struggled, with Piastri seventh and Norris eighth; Stroll clipped the pitwall at Turn 1 and was later asked to stop the car.

detailZh: 阿塞拜疆大奖赛：维斯塔潘在充满挑战的第三节练习赛中做出最快圈速，在排位赛前超越拉塞尔和梅赛德斯
维斯塔潘的速度表明他有望争夺红牛2026年的首个杆位；拉塞尔第二，汉密尔顿第三；排位赛将于周五下午1点在天空体育 F1和Main Event直播，阿塞拜疆大奖赛正赛将于周六中午12点进行。
拉塞尔在阿塞拜疆大奖赛第三节练习赛中险些撞墙。
维斯塔潘阻止了拉塞尔包揽练习赛最快圈速，红牛在周五晚些时候阿塞拜疆大奖赛排位赛前向梅赛德斯车手发起了新一轮挑战。
巴库街道赛道在第三节练习赛迎来了更具代表性的阵风天气，增加了这条被护墙包围的赛道的挑战性，多位车手在整整一小时的练习中因失误冲出赛道。
梅赛德斯在周四较为平静的条件下建立的统治地位最初得以延续，但维斯塔潘在软胎上找到了越来越快的速度，最终以1:43.922的最快圈速超越拉塞尔登上成绩榜首。

法拉利在练习赛大部分时间里都远远落后于领先节奏，但汉密尔顿在最后一圈升至第三，仅落后维斯塔潘0.111秒。
与早些时候他的红牛对手一样，汉密尔顿的最后一圈成绩得益于在巴库超长直道上从其他赛车获得的尾流，为他带来了额外的直线速度。
尾流和风都将成为排位赛杆位争夺的关键因素，排位赛将于下午1点在天空体育 F1和天空体育 Main Event直播。

"天气为我们带来了一个绝对精彩和戏剧性排位赛的可能性，"天空体育 F1的David Croft说道。
"这里的条件绝非想象中那么轻松。"
在积分榜上领先拉塞尔81分的安东内利排名第四，排在法拉利车手勒克莱尔之前。两位车手都曾冲出赛道。
三周前在同样高速的蒙扎赛道上做出惊艳一圈夺得个人首个F1杆位后，加斯利将他的阿尔派赛车排在第六，超过了迈凯伦车手。
尽管迈凯伦为巴库带来了大幅赛车升级，诺里斯在周四练习后就已经将卫冕世界冠军排除在杆位争夺之外，而这一预测在迈凯伦落后标杆0.8秒后看来是准确的。
皮亚斯特里排名第七，排在诺里斯之前，但两人都领先于红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔，后者因手腕伤势缺席三场比赛后似乎仍在恢复速度。
科拉平托驾驶第二辆阿尔派排名第十，紧随其后的是驾驶经过大幅修改的威廉姆斯赛车的塞恩斯，该车在周五上午展现出更多潜力，车队正努力加入围场中竞争激烈的中上游集团。
斯特罗尔在1号弯内侧护墙擦碰了他的阿斯顿·马丁赛车并停在缓冲区后，仅完成了九圈。

detailEn: Azerbaijan GP: Max Verstappen fastest in challenging final practice to usurp George Russell and Mercedes ahead of Qualifying

Max Verstappen's pace suggests he could vie for Red Bull's first pole position of 2026; George Russell second, Lewis Hamilton third; watch Qualifying later on Friday at 1pm with the Azerbaijan Grand Prix itself on Saturday at 12pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event
George Russell narrowly avoids hitting wall during the final practice session at the Azerbaijan GP.

Max Verstappen denied George Russell a clean sweep of fastest practice times as Red Bull led a renewed challenge to the Mercedes drivers ahead of Qualifying later on Friday at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.

The arrival of more characteristic gusty conditions on the streets of Baku for final practice increased the challenge around the wall-lined circuit, with numerous drivers running off track after errors throughout the hour.

Mercedes' dominance from Thursday's calmer running initially continued, but Verstappen found increasing pace on the soft tyres and eventually usurped Russell at the top of the timesheet with a best lap of 1:43.922.

Russell, who had a near-miss with the barriers at Turn Seven after running straight on, finished 0.099s behind in second.
Ferrari had been well behind the leading pace for most of the session but Lewis Hamilton moved into third with his final lap to finish only 0.111s adrift of Verstappen.
Like his Red Bull rival earlier in the session, Hamilton's final-lap time was boosted by a tow from other cars down Baku's mammoth pit straight, giving him extra straight-line speed.
Both the tow and the wind are set to be key factors in the battle for pole position in Qualifying, which gets under way at 1pm, live on Sky Sports F1 and Sky Sports Main Event.
Craig Slater breaks down the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, including why the race takes place on a Saturday, while doing his best Craig David impression!
"The weather has brought us the possibility of an absolutely fascinating and dramatic qualifying to come," said Sky Sports F1's David Croft.
"These are not easy conditions out there by any stretch of the imagination."
Kimi Antonelli, who leads Russell by 81 points in the championship, was fourth fastest ahead of the second Ferrari of Charles Leclerc. Both drivers were among those to have off-course moments.
Three weeks on from the stunning lap that took him to a maiden F1 pole at similarly high-speed Monza, Pierre Gasly put his Alpine up in sixth to outpace the McLarens.

Despite McLaren bringing a sizeable car upgrade to Baku, Lando Norris already ruled the reigning world champions out of pole contention after Thursday's running and that prediction appears accurate after they lapped 0.8s off the pace here.
Oscar Piastri was seventh fastest ahead of Norris, although both were ahead of Red Bull's Isack Hadjar who appears to still be getting back up to speed after a three-race absence with a wrist injury.

Franco Colapinto was 10th in the second Alpine, just ahead of Carlos Sainz in a heavily-revised Williams car which showed more promise on Friday morning as the team bid to join the grid's congested upper-midfield battle.
Lance Stroll completed only nine laps after tagging his Aston Martin against the inside wall at Turn One and stopping in the run-off area.
